steps.description:
The rate of beeping refers to how fast the beeping is. Each beep consists of a sound block and a wait block. The shorter the total time for each pair of sound and wait blocks, the faster the beeping rate.
     


Using a Comment block, write down which of the following is correct about the codes below:
a) Both the codes have the same beeping rate
b) Code A has a faster beeping rate
c) Code B has a faster beeping rate
